Method of Attack: Remote code execution vulnerability in Internet Explorer scripting engine handling objects in memory
Memory corruption leading to arbitrary code execution with user privileges
Exploitation via specially crafted websites or exploit kits
Downloading further malware, scripts, or executing commands with user privileges
Impacted Systems: Internet Explorer 11 on Windows 10, Windows 8.1, and Windows 7 SP1
Attack Vector: Compromised legitimate websites with injected exploit code
